name: Los Andes CRM
summary: A multi-company CRM that centralizes calls, customers, financial activity, users, and operational records across several business areas.
functions: Centralizes customers, social media and in-person interactions, tasks, and operational records across multiple companies, with access defined by role.
problem: Los Andes managed each company through spreadsheets without roles or data separation, giving everyone access to all information and making follow-up difficult to organize.
solution: I developed a custom multi-company CRM that organizes information and tasks by company, centralizes every interaction, and restricts access according to each responsibility.

demo.title: Private system
demo.description: Public access is unavailable because the platform belongs to the company and contains sensitive customer, financial, and operational data.
